summary: Both editions were independently checked against every clause of the supplied working Greek. Both preserve the moral assertions about sorrow, the cheerful-Spirit reading, both negative participles, the prayer/altar imagery, the difficult concluding prayer comparison, and the final promise and conditions, including “all cheerfulness.” The notes distinguish the selected readings from reported alternatives without importing versional explanations into the translation; the supplied second occurrence of “Spirit” is identified in the metadata as an English clarification. Acceptance is limited to this model review of the supplied source and disclosures; it does not verify the cited external witnesses, unseen images, or exhaustive collation.
